description: This file defines wizard interfaces for opening and filtering timesheet sheets based on department managers and states in an Odoo module.

classes.name: wiz_timesheet_open
classes.description: Wizard interface for opening timesheets related to department managers.

classes.name: wiz_timesheet_confirm_open
classes.description: Wizard interface for opening draft timesheets related to department managers.

classes.name: wiz_timesheet_validate_open
classes.description: Wizard interface for opening confirmed timesheets related to department managers.

methods.name: _open_timesheet
methods.description: Generates an action to open timesheets filtered by department manager and optionally by state.
